{{Short description|Venezuelan politician (born 1976)}}
{{distinguish|Gabriela Ramírez}}

'''Gabriela Servilia Jiménez Ramirez''' (born 19 August 1976) is a Venezuelan biologist and politician. She has been the Minister of Science and Technology since 6 June 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gabriela Jiménez Ramírez |url=https://poderopediave.org/persona/gabriela-jimenez-ramirez/ |access-date=2022-08-30 |website=Poderopedia Venezuela |language=es}}</ref>
